function.name: modify_painting
function.description: Modify an existing painting's attributes such as size, medium, and color.

size.description: The size of the painting in inches, width by height.

medium.description: The medium of the painting, such as oil, acrylic, etc.

dominant_color.description: The dominant color of the painting. Default to 'black'.
